Torn between Copyfy and AdEspresso? Both can serve an e-commerce project, but they don't play in the same league: one runs your business end to end, the other focuses on managing your Facebook ads.
• Copyfy (from 49€/month): the all-in-one suite covering AI product research, competitor store analysis, product page generation and importing visuals straight into Shopify.
• AdEspresso (from 49€/month): the Hootsuite group platform to create, test and optimize your Facebook and Instagram campaigns, with A/B testing and detailed reports.

Key takeaway: choose AdEspresso if you already manage a catalog and only want to steer your Facebook ads. But if you're looking to find products, analyze your competitors and run your store without stacking subscriptions, Copyfy does all of it in a single subscription.

Copyfy is a SaaS platform built for modern dropshippers who want to move fast without juggling ten tools. The starting idea is simple: bring together in one place everything it takes to launch and run a profitable store, from product research all the way to going live on Shopify.
AI product researchFast detection of opportunities and the market's winning products
Competitor analysisCompetitors' stores, prices and ad strategies put under the microscope
AI product page generatorSEO and conversion optimized descriptions, ready to publish
Visual import + ShopifyAutomatic copy of competitor images straight to your store
AI store builderGeneration of a complete store in a few minutes

Copyfy wins on versatility and value for money. Where you often have to pay for a product research tool, another for product pages and a third for store analysis, Copyfy bundles it all into a simple interface, accessible to beginners and experienced users alike. The free trial and a 5-day free trial take the risk out of testing.

Copyfy is not an ad campaign manager: it helps you find products and build the store, but it doesn't run your Facebook ad delivery day to day. If your only need is to create and mass-test ads on Meta, an ad-only tool will go further on that specific point.

column1: AdEspresso: the Facebook and Instagram ad manager

AdEspresso, acquired by Hootsuite, made a name for itself in creating and optimizing Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns. Its promise: simplify setting up your ads, multiply tests and give you clear reports to improve your performance. It's a tool geared toward paid acquisition above all.
Campaign creationSimplified interface to launch Facebook and Instagram ads
Advanced A/B testingMass-test ad variants to optimize performance
Detailed reportsIn-depth analytics to track and steer your campaigns
Marketing integrationsConnection with Google Analytics and HubSpot
Recognized supportExtensive documentation and quality customer support

AdEspresso shines on ad management. If your job revolves around Facebook and Instagram campaigns, you launch a lot of tests and you want clear reports to optimize your media budget, its A/B testing and analytics save real time. It's a reference for marketers and agencies focused on paid acquisition.

AdEspresso stays centered on advertising. It offers no product research tool, doesn't analyze competitor stores, doesn't generate product pages and doesn't integrate with Shopify. Its interface is English only, its entry point is higher (49€/month) and it doesn't cover dropshipping end to end.

Copyfy or Dropship Spy: the quick answer

Torn between Copyfy and Dropship Spy? Both help you succeed in dropshipping, but they don't play in the same league: one runs your business end to end, the other focuses on a product database and social ad analysis.
• Copyfy (from 49€/month): the all-in-one suite covering AI product research, competitor store analysis, product page generation and visual import straight into Shopify.
• Dropship Spy (from 39€/month): a product research tool backed by a Facebook ad database and social statistics, built to spot the products that are buzzing.

Key takeaway: pick Dropship Spy if you mainly want to browse a product database and follow the Facebook ads that are running. But if you're looking to find products, analyze your competitors and run your store without stacking subscriptions, Copyfy does all of that in a single subscription.

Copyfy is a SaaS platform built for modern dropshippers who want to move fast without juggling ten tools. The starting idea is simple: bring together in one place everything you need to launch and run a profitable store, from product research to going live on Shopify.
AI product researchFast detection of opportunities and winning products on the market
Competitor analysisCompetitors' stores, prices and ad strategies put under the microscope
AI product page generatorSEO and conversion optimized descriptions, ready to publish
Visual import + ShopifyAutomatic copy of competitor images straight to your store
AI store creationGeneration of a complete store in a few minutes

Copyfy wins on versatility and value for money. Where you usually have to pay for a product research tool, another for product pages and a third for store analysis, Copyfy bundles it all into a simple interface, accessible to beginners and experienced users alike. The free trial and a 5-day free trial remove the risk when you test it.

It's still a young tool: its pure ad database is shallower than that of an ad spy specialist. If your only need is to dig through thousands of ad creatives all day long, a 100% advertising tool will go further on that specific point.

column1: Dropship Spy: the product database backed by social ads

Dropship Spy made a name for itself as a product research tool paired with an ad database. Its promise: give you access to a regularly updated product catalog and show you the Facebook ads that are running, backed by social statistics. It's a trend-discovery tool above all.

Dropship Spy shines on product discovery. If your need is to browse a ready-to-use product database and keep an eye on the Facebook ads that perform, it does the job. It's a good starting point to spot products that are buzzing and feed your social campaign ideas.

Dropship Spy stays more limited on the e-commerce side. It doesn't analyze competitor stores, doesn't generate SEO-optimized product pages and doesn't import visuals to Shopify. Its less automated nature and the lack of direct integration weigh in when you're after a complete solution, and it offers no free trial to test it risk-free.

Stuck between Copyfy and Spocket? Both serve dropshippers, but they don't play in the same league: one finds products and runs your store end to end, the other connects you with suppliers to stock up.
• Copyfy (from €49/month): the all-in-one suite covering AI product research, competitor store analysis, product page generation and image imports straight into Shopify.
• Spocket (from €39/month): a sourcing platform with a catalog of Europe and US suppliers, built to cut delivery times through local stock.

Bottom line: pick Spocket if your priority is finding local suppliers and shipping fast. But if you want to find products, analyze your competitors and run your store without stacking subscriptions, Copyfy covers far more in a single subscription, with a free trial Spocket doesn't have.

Copyfy: from product research to a live store

Copyfy handles the problem end to end. You look for a product that sells, you check what the competing store takes in, you pull the advertising angle that works. Then you generate the product page and the store around it, all from the same interface.

Key features

FeatureWhat it gives you
Product researchProduct database with real sales data, filters by niche, price and growth
Ad intelligenceMeta and TikTok creatives: angle, format and run duration
Store analysisEstimated traffic, estimated revenue, the products driving the numbers
AI store builderProduct page and store generated around the chosen product, natively on Shopify or WooCommerce
Visuals and copyProduct images and descriptions generated, ready to import

Why pick Copyfy

  • One subscription instead of an ad spy plus a product research tool plus a copy generator.
  • TikTok covered on the same footing as Meta, where half the products now start.
  • Estimated revenue on a competitor store, a figure most ad spies never show.
  • Five days of trial with no card, enough to judge on evidence.

Copyfy limitations

  • The entry ticket sits above a standalone ad spy, which follows from the wider scope.
  • Revenue and traffic stay estimates, not official figures pulled from an API.
  • A media buyer who only wants creatives will pay for modules they never open.

Dropispy: the low-cost Meta ad spy

Dropispy is run by a Swiss company based in Geneva, specialised in data collection. Its promise fits in one line: index commerce ads on Facebook and Instagram, then tie each one to the product and the store behind it.

Key features

FeatureWhat it gives you
Ad database50M+ Meta ads with likes, shares and comments
Shop spy400,000 stores ranked by traffic, with their current products
Chrome extensionData overlaid on your feed and on the product pages you visit
Ecommerce filtersDate, country, language, media type, interactions, target gender and age
Credit system150,000 credits on Premium, around 350 research sessions a month

Why pick Dropispy

  • The entry ticket is among the lowest in the category against $149 platforms.
  • The ad to store link saves you from guessing who runs the creative.
  • The Chrome extension works from the free plan, with no card at signup.
  • Support answers fast, including live chat on paid plans.

Dropispy limitations

  • Facebook and Instagram only: no TikTok, no Google, no Pinterest.
  • Short history, independent tests rarely reach past three months.
  • No revenue, no margin, no acquisition cost.
  • The free plan hides the last two months of ads and locks shop spy.
  • No bulk export: creatives are handled one at a time inside the interface.

The pricing verdict depends on what you count in. Dropispy alone costs less. Dropispy plus a product research tool plus a copy generator costs more than Copyfy, for a result split across three interfaces.

Which tool to choose

You sell on Meta only with a tight budget, take Dropispy

One market, one ad network, competitors on Shopify, under $1,000 of monthly ad spend: Dropispy does the job for $29.90. Shop spy traces the ad back to the bestseller, which is what you came for.

You want to go from spotted product to live store, take Copyfy

The moment TikTok enters your mix, you want a competitor's estimated revenue or you stall on building the store, Copyfy covers the chain Dropispy leaves open. For about twenty euros more a month, you replace two or three subscriptions.

You run several clients in an agency, look wider

Both tools show their limits on multi-client work: Dropispy exports nothing in bulk. An agency across several markets needs more than one network covered. Compare with the other platforms before committing.

FAQ

Copyfy or Dropispy, which is better

It depends where you stop. To spot a Meta ad and trace it back to the store, Dropispy is enough and costs less. To validate the product with sales data, cover TikTok and build the store, Copyfy does the work Dropispy does not.

Is Dropispy cheaper than Copyfy

Yes, $29.90 against €49, roughly twenty euros apart. The maths change as soon as you add the tools you will still need behind: product research, copy generation, store creation.

Does Dropispy cover TikTok

No. Coverage stops at Facebook and Instagram. No TikTok, YouTube, Google or Pinterest data is indexed, while Copyfy covers Meta and TikTok.

Is the Dropispy free plan enough to find a product

Barely. The last two months of ads are hidden and shop spy is locked. You explore the interface, you do not run real product research.

Can you test both tools for free

Dropispy offers a permanent free plan. There is no trial of its paid plan. Copyfy gives 5 days of full trial with no card required.

Verdict: our recommendation

For most dropshippers, Copyfy

Finding the ad was never the real problem. It starts after: knowing whether the product sells, at what price, then building the store that converts. Copyfy holds that chain end to end for €49 a month, with a 5 day trial and no card.

For pure Meta spying, Dropispy

If your need stops at ad monitoring on Facebook and Instagram, on a tight budget, Dropispy stays a good deal at $29.90. Keep the short history and the complete absence of sales figures in mind.
